title: Programmatic DOOH Trends in 2026: How Self-Serve is Lowering Barriers for Local Brands

facts.fact: The article states that traditional outdoor media campaigns often demanded a minimum commitment of $25,000 or more.
facts.quote: It was not uncommon for traditional outdoor media campaigns to demand a minimum commitment of $25,000 or more.

facts.fact: In the article's comparison table (vendor's own framing), traditional managed DOOH has high minimum budgets, often $10,000 to $25,000+.
The vendor's article says that programmatic self-serve DOOH (Take 10 Media) offers flexible micro-budgets with no high minimums.
The vendor's article says traditional managed DOOH requires rigid, long-term contracts, while the self-serve option is pay-as-you-go and can be paused or adjusted anytime.
The vendor's article claims that highway billboard viewers have dwell times often only 3 to 5 seconds.
facts.quote: extremely short dwell times (often only 3 to 5 seconds)

facts.fact: The vendor claims that a video ad on a convenience store or ATM screen captures attention for 1 to 3 minutes.
facts.quote: your video ad captures their attention for 1 to 3 minutes in a distraction-free environment.

facts.fact: The vendor says Take 10 Media's creative review is automated or rapid, taking under 24-48 hours, versus several days for traditional managed campaigns.
facts.quote: Automated or rapid digital review (under 24-48 hours)

facts.fact: The vendor states its self-serve Ad Portal is available for buying 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
facts.unit: hours per day, days per week
facts.quote: Instant digital buying via a 24/7 [Ad Portal]

facts.fact: The article was published on June 16, 2026.
Take 10 Media recommends that self-serve local DOOH creative be a short vertical video with a 9:16 aspect ratio.
facts.quote: Prepare a short, visually compelling vertical video (9:16 aspect ratio)

facts.fact: Take 10 Media says advertisers can set a daily or monthly budget on its self-serve platform.
facts.quote: Establish a comfortable daily or monthly budget that aligns with your marketing goals.

facts.fact: On Take 10 Media's self-serve platform, advertisers can target specific neighborhoods, ZIP codes, or convenience store and ATM locations.
facts.quote: Identify the specific neighborhoods, ZIP codes, or convenience store and ATM locations

facts.fact: Take 10 Media's self-serve real-time dashboard tracks play counts and impressions for campaigns.
facts.quote: Use your real-time dashboard to track play counts and impressions.

facts.fact: Take 10 Media says advertisers can instantly reallocate budget to locations that perform exceptionally well.
facts.quote: If certain locations are performing exceptionally well, instantly reallocate your budget to maximize your ROI.

facts.fact: Take 10 Media describes its self-serve launch process as four steps: define target area, set budget, upload creative, and monitor and optimize.
facts.quote: you can have your ads running on premium local screens in just a few simple steps

facts.fact: Take 10 Media advises that DOOH creative include a clear call-to-action and high-contrast design.
facts.quote: featuring a clear call-to-action and a high-contrast design
